row.Locator: p. 3: RECOMMENDED PRINTING CONDITIONS

notes.Text: ⚫ Bed Temperature Settings: A bed temperature of 40-50℃ typically provides adequate adhesion. If stronger adhesion is needed, you may increase the temperature but avoid exceeding 60℃ to prevent excessive sticking.

⚫ Not recommended to be printed on textured PEI as this material has an extra high bed adhesion properties and can damage the bed. We recommend using Magigoo Original or Vision Miner Adhesive to help with print release if using a textured PEI plate.
